cohort: 81 women with dichorionic twin pregnancies who underwent late selective termination between 2009 and 2021
finding: Late second trimester selective termination is associated with a higher birthweight centile and lower rates of IUGR and Caesarean delivery, compared with third trimester selective termination.
gest_age: 20.2 to 24.2 weeks for group A, ≥28.2 weeks for group B
